jobs.description:
Get ready for an energetic job as a Warehouse Employee at UPS in Herkenbosch! Earn up to €22,50 per hour including shift allowances. Receive your salary weekly and enjoy clear growth opportunities. In this flexible role, you label, sort, pack, and scan products together with great colleagues. Ready to boost your career at UPS? Apply now and get started right away!

What we offer
- 💰€15,00 bruto every hour
- 🚗 Travel allowance up to €9,47 netto
- 🌙 50% shift allowance (between 00:00 and 06:00)
- 🥳 A dynamic team with a great atmosphere
- 📈 Growth opportunities to operator or team leader
- 💸 Weekly salary payment

Who you are
To join UPS in Herkenbosch, you love variety and action. Further requirements:

- You speak and understand English well.
- You are flexibly available to work in 2 or 3 rotating shifts ans also on weekends.
- You have your own transport to reach the work location in Herkenbosch.

What will you do
Every day brings a new challenge at UPS in Herkenbosch! You make sure products are delivered to customers on time and in top shape. One day you are labeling items, and the next you are sorting, scanning, or packing orders. Active work that keeps you moving!

- Labeling, packing, and sorting various products.
- Scanning packages and preparing them for shipment.
- Working together with your team to hit daily targets.

Where will you work
UPS in Herkenbosch is a global leader in logistics. You will work in a modern warehouse with friendly colleagues who support each other. Hard work is rewarded with great shift allowances and a lively work atmosphere!

- Working in a modern warehouse
- great shift allowances
- Lively work atmosphere

Job application
Ready to start your new job at UPS? Apply today! You will receive a response within 1 business day. (Or via WhatsApp within 15 minutes if Digital Validation is active).  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

jobs.description:
Part-Time Night Job, Full-Time Fun! If the idea of working under the moonlight excites you, Manpower has the perfect opportunity! We’re hiring mail sorters for PostNL in Nieuwegein (Grote Wade 80, 3439 NT). With no fixed hours but shifts lasting 3 to 5 hours, you'll need to be flexible and ready to work at least 15 hours weekly. Bring your own ride, and let’s sort through some mail and make the night count!

 

Manpower employment agency is looking for mail sorters for night shifts at PostNL in Nieuwegein. 

 

In the role of a mail sorter, you’ll handle the machine sorting of national mail. The job requires physical effort—you’ll stand for long periods and regularly lift heavy mail trays. Precision is crucial because every piece of mail needs to arrive at the right destination.

 

What's in it for you 

    - From the age of 18 a gross salary of €14.99 (excluding bonuses)
    
- Reimbursement of travel costs 
    
- Temporary employment contract  
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower 
    
- Free access to E-learning platform Manpower Academy 
    
- Irregularity allowance of 20% for working between 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM, and 40% for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM

    - Strong command of Dutch and/or English to ensure clear communication and adherence to safety guidelines
    
- Own transportation to accommodate working early mornings, evenings, and night shifts
    
- Capability to submit a valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)

Excited to start your journey at PostNL? Submit your application now, and Manpower will reach out within two business days!

As a Warehouse employee for GXO, you perform different tasks. From offloading trucks and storing goods on the right location, stock management, picking orders, checking orders or loading trucks with outgoing packages, it is all part of the job. You will be working in an international team in a warm atmosphere. GXO celebrates succeses, so don't be surprised if they hand out icecreams during summer time, or a cake for someones birthday. You will work in a fixed schedule together with your teamleader. One week morning shift from 06.00 to 15.00, next week afternoon shift from 13.00 until 22.00 hrs. Working days are monday to friday. On occasion they work Saturdays. As a warehouse employee you are the key to our clients succes. Its important you pay attention to detail, because the packages you collect are part of a combination. One wrong package and the whole system does not work. 

- You have to have your own transportation (public transport not available at beginning of the shift)
- Full time available from Monday to Friday, in two shifts.
- Physically fit and comfortable with active work (you lift packages up to 25 kg). 
- Speaks good English or Dutch
- VOG required (application will be done after your start).
